picks.editorial_note: DOE tapped Berkeley Lab to lead 13 Genesis Mission AI projects and partner on 30+ more, making it one of the largest single awards in the initiative and signaling the lab's central role in the national AI-for-science push.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge National Laboratory was selected to lead nine Genesis Mission projects and contribute to 32 others, reflecting a massive concentration of federal AI research investment at one facility.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: Sandia National Laboratories will lead six Genesis Mission projects and partner on 17 more, another top-tier allocation showing how DOE labs are anchoring the national AI-for-science infrastructure.
picks.title: Sandia selected to lead six Genesis Mission projects, partner on 17 others

picks.editorial_note: NASA's entry into the Genesis Mission, alongside 15+ other federal agencies under a whole-of-government executive order, marks a significant expansion of the initiative's scope beyond DOE and signals a coordinated federal AI research policy shift.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: University of Florida's six-year AI review reveals $511 million in cumulative AI research funding since 2017, illustrating the scale of sustained institutional investment behind the current AI research boom.
picks.title: AI year in review

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20M NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node demonstrates how AI-enabled automated science infrastructure is being built out as a distributed national network, not just single-institution funding.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: Boston University's matching $20M NSF award for a biotech-focused cloud lab node shows the same national automated-science network taking shape across multiple disciplines and institutions.
picks.title: NSF Awards Boston University $20 Million to Help Create National “Cloud Lab” Network

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT are deepening an international AI and robotics partnership with dedicated researcher exchanges, a concrete example of cross-border academic collaboration accelerating applied AI research.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: RIKEN's launch of the Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program to build generative AI foundation models and agents represents a major international bet on AI-driven scientific discovery outside the U.S.-centric Genesis Mission umbrella.
picks.title: TRIP Headquarters Advanced General Intelligence for Science Program (AGIS)

picks.editorial_note: A new deep learning model from CMU, Pitt, and UW researchers revealed differences in 3D genome architecture linked to Alzheimer's disease, a genuine scientific breakthrough with direct implications for understanding neurodegenerative disease.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease
